scripts.bundle:android: npx react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle --assets-dest android/app/src/main/res
scripts.install:device: npm run bundle:android && cd android && gradlew.bat app:assembleDebug && adb push app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk /data/local/tmp/child.apk && adb shell pm install -r /data/local/tmp/child.apk
scripts.release:device: cd android && gradlew.bat app:assembleRelease && adb push app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk /data/local/tmp/child-release.apk && adb shell pm install -r /data/local/tmp/child-release.apk && adb shell am start -n com.caretrack.child/com.helloworld.MainActivity
